description: The diagnostic codes that no compiler fixture produces, each with its reason (decisions 0027 item 11 and 0093). Read by crates/mtek-compiler/tests/fixtures.rs (every_catalogue_code_has_a_fixture_or_a_listed_reason) and by tools/coverage-matrix, which shows the lists in docs/coverage-matrix.md. A code that gains a fixture must leave its list. Paths are relative to the repository root; a named test file must contain the code.

reserved.reason: Retired by decision 0141: go_to(Scene) switches the active scene, so no program can produce it; the catalogue keeps the code so that the number is not reused.
No construct of v0.1 asks for transparency (spec/materials.md section 2: opaque materials only), so no program can produce it; the context export lists the feature as not supported.
v0.1 has at most 4 inter-stage variables (spec/materials.md section 3.3) and no custom vertex stage (E4901), so the limit of 16 cannot be reached; custom vertex stages are v0.2.

The naming lint is not part of v0.1 (spec/language.md section 3.3 as amended by decision 0102; decision 0070 item 11): neither the compiler nor mtek fmt implements it, the catalogue keeps the code so that the number is not reused, and no program can produce it.

unreachable.reason: Only a compiler defect produces it (Naga rejecting generated WGSL).
Only a compiler defect produces it.
